lastCompletedStory.title: Add central readIssueSystem reader and wire ship-finalize + ship-pr to 'local'

openQuestions: scripts/build-release.sh AC4 smoke still passes '--issue-system none' to the compiled binary (carried over from US-001's handoff; still not in scope for US-002/US-003/US-004).

src/commands/issue-list.ts:166 still reads issue_system via the loose 'typeof config[...] === string ? ... : none' inline pattern (not readIssueSystem) -- this is US-003's explicit target ('sweep remaining none fixtures'), left untouched here on purpose to keep this story's diff to its named sites (ship-finalize.ts, ship-pr.ts, the new config module).

src/commands/setup.ts hit the file-size ratchet ceiling (838->839, one import line added for the re-exported IssueSystem type) and was bumped in scripts/file-size-budget.json with a CAM-236 tracker ref in the same commit.
nextStoryContext: US-003 is next: wire issue-list.ts to readIssueSystem (src/config/issue-system.ts, added this story) and sweep any other remaining scattered 'none' reads/fixtures across the codebase (grep '\'none\'' and 'issue_system' outside vendor/templates). Known site: src/commands/issue-list.ts:166 ('none' fallback + :168 'linear'||'github' branch feeding backendHint/emitSectionHeading) -- readIssueSystem now throws on invalid values instead of defaulting, so any call site that currently treats an absent/invalid issue_system as an inert 'none' sentinel needs to decide whether 'local' is a no-op branch (skip the Linear/GitHub-only summary block) or needs its own explicit handling. IssueSystem type now lives in src/config/issue-system.ts (readIssueSystem(config: Record<string,unknown>): IssueSystem, throws on invalid incl. legacy 'none'); src/commands/setup.ts re-exports it for existing importers (SetupScreen.tsx). project.toml/docs/templates/CHANGELOG none->local migration is US-004's explicit scope, not US-003's.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal config-reader addition (readIssueSystem) plus string-literal rename ('none'->'local') in comparisons/comments across two existing modules and their tests; no new API surface of any external library (js-yaml, Bun.TOML, Ink, etc.) was exercised.
